answer: A bank of pre-written answers as a result has nothing to key against, and filling 255 aliases means authoring 255 texts that each match their own nonce. Because the derivation is bound to the terrace signature, the relic gate rejects a mismatch, and the nebula checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 58 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
